```{r Setup}
library(brms)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(posterior)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(123)


df_general <- read_csv("df_general.csv", show_col_types = F)
df_prolific <- read_csv("df_prolific.csv", show_col_types = F)

df <- rbind(df_general, df_prolific) |>
      filter(Progress == 100 & RegStatus != 4) |>
      subset(select = -c(Progress))

vig <- read_csv("scoring_profiles.csv")

tech_list <- read_csv("techniques.csv")

```

```{r Demographics}
# Save demographics
demo <- df[, 1:11]

clin_age <- mean(demo$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
clin_age_sd <- sd(demo$Age, na.rm = TRUE)
print(paste0("The mean age of all 95 participants was: ", clin_age))
print(paste0("The SD was: ", clin_age_sd))

gender <- demo |> 
  count(Gender) |>                    
  mutate(percent = scales::percent(n / sum(n))) 
gender

culture <- demo |> 
  count(Culture) |>                    
  mutate(percent = scales::percent(n / sum(n))) 
culture

culture_other <- na.omit(demo$Culture_12_TEXT)
print(paste0("Other cultures: ", paste(unique(culture_other), collapse = "; ")))

role <- demo |> 
  count(RegStatus) |>                    
  mutate(percent = scales::percent(n / sum(n))) 
role


experience <- mean(demo$Years_exp, na.rm = TRUE)
experience_sd <- sd(demo$Years_exp, na.rm = TRUE)
print(paste0("The mean number of years of experience was: ", experience))
print(paste0("The SD was: ", experience_sd))

service <- demo |> 
  count(Service) |>                    
  mutate(percent = scales::percent(n / sum(n))) 
service

service_other <- na.omit(demo$Service_7_TEXT)
print(paste0("Other roles: ", paste(unique(service_other), collapse = "; ")))
```


```{r Wrangle}

# Save K10-related columns
k10_df <- df[, c(1, 434:454)]



# Recode
# Treatments not picked = 0
for (v in 1:20) {
  
  seen_col <- paste0("V", v, "_tx")
  
  df <- df |> 
    mutate(
      across(
        starts_with(paste0("V", v, "_tx_rank_")),
        ~ replace(., !is.na(.data[[seen_col]]) & is.na(.), 0)
      )
    )
}



# Remove K10 columns
df <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(-matches("^K10(_tx(_rank_\\d+)?|$)"))

# Remove unneeded vignette columns
df <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(-matches("^V\\d+_tx$"))

# Convert to long format
long_df <- df |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^V\\d+_tx_rank_"),
    names_to = c("vignette", "technique_id"),
    names_pattern = "V(\\d+)_tx_rank_(\\d+)",
    values_to = "rank"
  )

# Add a "selected" variable
long_df <- long_df |> 
  mutate(selected = ifelse(is.na(rank), NA,
                           ifelse(rank == 0, 0, 1)))

long_df <- merge(long_df, vig, by = "vignette")

long_df <- long_df |>
  mutate(
    technique_id = factor(technique_id),
    vignette = factor(vignette),
    ID = factor(ID)
  )


long_df <- long_df |>
  filter(!is.na(rank))

long_df <- long_df |>
  mutate(
    rank_cat = case_when(
      rank == 0 ~ 0,
      rank == 5 ~ 1,
      rank == 4 ~ 2,
      rank == 3 ~ 3,
      rank == 2 ~ 4,
      rank == 1 ~ 5
    )
  )

long_df <- long_df |>
  mutate(
    rank_cat = factor(rank_cat,
                      levels = 0:5,
                      ordered = TRUE)
  )

```

```{r Bayesian Hierarchical Logisitic Model}


fit_ord <- brm(
  rank_cat ~ technique_id * (z1 + z2 + z3 + z4) +
             (1 | ID) + 
             (1 | vignette),
  data = long_df,
  family = cumulative(link = "logit"),
  cores = 4, chains = 4, iter = 2000, seed = 123
)

summary(fit_ord)

```


```{r Expected suitability for each Dimension × Technique}


dims <- c("z1","z2","z3","z4")
mid  <- 5
low  <- 2
high <- 8

delta_expected_suitability <- function(dim_name){
  
  techs <- levels(long_df$technique_id)
  
  new_low <- data.frame(
    z1 = mid, z2 = mid, z3 = mid, z4 = mid,
    technique_id = factor(techs, levels = techs)
  )
  
  new_high <- new_low
  
  new_low[[dim_name]]  <- low
  new_high[[dim_name]] <- high
  
  p_low  <- posterior_epred(fit_ord, newdata=new_low,  re_formula = NA)
  p_high <- posterior_epred(fit_ord, newdata=new_high, re_formula = NA)
  
  # rank values 0:5
  rank_vals <- 0:5
  
  # Compute expected value for each draw and technique
  E_low  <- apply(p_low,  c(1,2), function(p) sum(p * rank_vals))
  E_high <- apply(p_high, c(1,2), function(p) sum(p * rank_vals))
  
  delta  <- E_high - E_low
  
  summary_delta <- apply(delta, 2,
                         function(x) c(mean = mean(x),
                                       l = quantile(x, .025),
                                       u = quantile(x, .975)))
  
  out <- as.data.frame(t(summary_delta))
  out$technique_id <- techs
  out$dimension <- dim_name
  
  out
}

dim_maps <- bind_rows(lapply(dims, delta_expected_suitability))


```


```{r Rank techniques for each dimension}

ranked_maps <- dim_maps %>%
  group_by(dimension) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(mean > 0, "increases", "decreases")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(dimension = recode(dimension, 'z1' = 'Uncontrollable thinking patterns',
                            'z2' = 'Re-experiencing difficult events',
                            'z3' = 'Rigid high standards',
                            'z4' = 'Emotional agency'))
ranked_maps <- merge(ranked_maps, tech_list, by = "technique_id")

print(ranked_maps)

ranked_maps$dimension <- as_factor(ranked_maps$dimension)

```


```{r Heatmap}

ggplot(ranked_maps,
       aes(x = dimension,
           y = reorder(technique, mean),
           fill = mean)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mean)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue",
                       mid = "white",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 0) +
  labs(title = "Change in Expected Suitability",
       x = "Dimension",
       y = "Treatment Technique",
       fill = "Δ Expected\nSuitability") +
  theme_minimal()

```



```{r K10 data wrangling}

# Convert to long format
long_k10_df <- k10_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("K10_tx_rank_"),
    names_to = "technique_id",
    names_pattern = "K10_tx_rank_(\\d+)",
    values_to = "rank"
  )

long_k10_df <- long_k10_df %>%
  mutate(rank = ifelse(is.na(rank), 0, rank))

long_k10_df <- long_k10_df %>%
  mutate(
    rank_cat = case_when(
      rank == 0 ~ 0,
      rank == 5 ~ 1,
      rank == 4 ~ 2,
      rank == 3 ~ 3,
      rank == 2 ~ 4,
      rank == 1 ~ 5
    ),
    rank_cat = factor(rank_cat,
                      levels = 0:5,
                      ordered = TRUE),
    technique_id = factor(technique_id),
    ID = factor(ID)
  )
```


```{r K10 analysis}

fit_k10 <- brm(
  rank_cat ~ technique_id * K10 +
             (1 | ID),
  data = long_k10_df,
  family = cumulative(link = "logit"),
  cores = 4, chains = 4, iter = 2000
)

```

```{r}
low_k10  <- 20
high_k10 <- 25
mid_k10  <- 30

delta_expected_k10 <- function(){
  
  techs <- levels(long_k10_df$technique_id)
  
  new_low <- data.frame(
    K10 = low_k10,
    technique_id = factor(techs, levels = techs)
  )
  
  new_high <- data.frame(
    K10 = high_k10,
    technique_id = factor(techs, levels = techs)
  )
  
  # posterior category probabilities
  p_low  <- posterior_epred(fit_k10, newdata = new_low,  re_formula = NA)
  p_high <- posterior_epred(fit_k10, newdata = new_high, re_formula = NA)
  
  rank_vals <- 0:5
  
  # Expected suitability
  E_low  <- apply(p_low,  c(1,2), function(p) sum(p * rank_vals))
  E_high <- apply(p_high, c(1,2), function(p) sum(p * rank_vals))
  
  delta <- E_high - E_low
  
  summary_delta <- apply(delta, 2,
                         function(x) c(mean = mean(x),
                                       l = quantile(x, .025),
                                       u = quantile(x, .975)))
  
  out <- as.data.frame(t(summary_delta))
  out$technique_id <- techs
  out$dimension <- "K10"
  
  out
}

k10_maps <- delta_expected_k10()

combined_maps <- bind_rows(dim_maps, k10_maps)

ranked_maps <- combined_maps %>%
  group_by(dimension) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(direction = ifelse(mean > 0, "increases", "decreases")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(dimension = recode(dimension, 'z1' = 'Uncontrollable thinking patterns',
                            'z2' = 'Re-experiencing difficult events',
                            'z3' = 'Rigid high standards',
                            'z4' = 'Emotional agency'))
ranked_maps <- merge(ranked_maps, tech_list, by = "technique_id")

ranked_maps$dimension <- factor(ranked_maps$dimension,
                                  levels = c("Uncontrollable thinking patterns","Re-experiencing difficult events","Rigid high standards","Emotional agency","K10"))

maps_ordered <- ranked_maps[order(ranked_maps$dimension),] %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(c("mean", "l.2.5%", "u.97.5%"), round, 2)) %>%
  subset(select = -c(direction, technique_id))

write.csv(maps_ordered, "technique_CI.csv", row.names = FALSE)

ggplot(ranked_maps,
       aes(x = dimension,
           y = reorder(technique, mean),
           fill = mean)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", mean)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue",
                       mid = "white",
                       high = "red",
                       midpoint = 0) +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  labs(title = "Change in Expected Suitability",
       x = "Mental Health Dimension",
       y = "Treatment Technique",
       fill = "Δ Expected\nSuitability") +
  theme_minimal()
```




```{r Bayesian Hierarchical Logisitic Model - add clinical variables}

# Ensure correct data types
long_df <- long_df |>
  mutate(
    RegStatus = factor(RegStatus),
    Service = factor(Service),
    Years_exp = as.numeric(Years_exp),
  )


fit_adj <- brm(
  rank_cat ~ technique_id * (z1 + z2 + z3 + z4) +
             RegStatus + Years_exp + Service +
             (1 | ID) +
             (1 | vignette),
  data = long_df,
  family = cumulative(link = "logit"),
  cores = 4, chains = 4, iter = 2000, seed = 123
)

loo_base <- loo(fit_ord)
loo_adj  <- loo(fit_adj)

loo_compare(loo_base, loo_adj)

```
